Here are the top Decks in the competition, in the middle of Round 5 here at YCS Raleigh! These are the Decks that we see taking up spots in the Top 20 tables.

Snake-Eye and Voiceless Voice are leading the charge here at YCS Raleigh. Combined, they take up more than 40% of the Decks at the top 20 tables! Here’s the Deck breakdown for the top 20 tables in Round 6 of YCS Raleigh!

Snake-Eye and Fire King Snake-Eye Decks are leading at the top tables, with 7 Duelists at the top 20 tables piloting each of those two Decks. The numbers fall of from there, with each of the remaining Decks at the top 20 tables being represented by 1 or 2 Duelists using them. Follow the coverage to see which Decks continue to succeed as the tournament progresses!

Top Tables Update: Round 7

Here in Round 7 of YCS Raleigh, Fire King Snake-Eye Decks have emerged as the most popular Deck at the top 20 tables. Nine Duelists at the top 20 tables are currently piloting them, with pure Snake-Eye variants trailing behind with 8 Duelists at the top 20 tables using them. Voiceless Voice Decks are now the third most represented Deck at the top 20 tables with 6 Duelists piloting them – an increase in representation since our Round 6 Top Tables Update. Kashtira Snake-Eye Decks are trailing behind with 4 Duelists using them in the top 20 tables. The rest of the Decks at the top 20 tables have 1 or 2 Duelists using them, but there are a wide variety of interesting Decks. These Decks include Salamangreat, Runick Plunder Patroll, and Volcanic Snake-Eye strategies.

There are still over a dozen different types of Decks at the top 20 tables in Round 7, and any one of them can win YCS Raleigh. Follow the coverage to see which Decks prevail as the tournament progresses!

Top Tables Update: Round 8

Snake-Eye Decks are dominating the top tables in Round 8, with 8 Duelists running pure Snake-Eye variants, 7 Duelists running Fire King Snake-Eye Decks, and 4 Duelists using Kashtira Snake-Eye Decks. Combined, that’s nearly 50% of the Decks at the top 20 tables. Kashtira Decks are now the most represented non-FIRE Deck at the top 20 tables, with 4 Duelists currently piloting a Kashtira Deck. There’s still quite a bit of variety at the top tables though, with Vanquish Soul, Horus, and Runick Decks included among the many Decks present at the top 20 tables.
Follow the coverage to see how the rest of the event unfolds!

We are going into the last round of Swiss for Day 1 here at YCS Raleigh. Looking at the Top 20 tables, here is a breakdown of the 40 decks at the top tables that are still Dueling it out for a spot in the Top 32 tomorrow.

FIRE Decks are still dominating as Snake-Eye builds both with and without Fire King cards take up more than a quarter of the Decks at the top tables of the competition. Trailing behind the Snake-Eye strategies are Floowandereeze, Kashtira Snake-Eye, Runick, and Voiceless Voice. All these powerful decks have been seeing a lot of success here this weekend at YCS Raleigh.

With just 1 round of Swiss left tonight, the tensions are high as the Duelists are trying to lock in their slots in the single-elimination rounds. The competition is looking like mostly Snake-Eye strategies dominating the event.
